title: Snowball Rush IO
description: Roll a giant snowball across frosty arenas, scoop up snow to grow massive, and bump rival players right off the ice rink!
controls: Drag to roll your snowball bigger across the ice and release to hurl or bump rivals off the edge.

zh-CN.title: 奔跑吧雪球
zh-CN.description: 魔性 IO 竞技奔跑吧雪球：滚起巨无霸雪球把对手统统撞飞冰面，活到最后成为冰雪王者！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动滚大雪球，松手发射或正面冲撞把所有对手顶出冰台即可获胜。
